verdict.rationale: Whisper ships a pip-installable command-line tool (`whisper audio.mp3 --model turbo`, with language and translate flags) and a Python API (`whisper.load_model(...).transcribe(...)`). The hosted API also has a command-line path (`openai audio:transcriptions create`) that returns JSON, so it can be scripted non-interactively for automation. However, nothing documents CI usage specifically, and community reports note CPU-only inference of larger models is very slow, which matters on typical GPU-less CI runners. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless documentation (non-interactive auth, exit codes, runner setup), guidance for running on CPU-only CI hardware, independent reports of CI pipeline use.
